By sheer coincidence, Alice is wearing a bunny costume.
Ecstatic, she proceeds to spend her time meeting various rabbit-related characters at Coin Rush.

lines.text: Here I come!

My tail isn't moving when I walk, is it?
Can you check it for me?

Are these carrots in my hair edible?
May I eat them?

The main reason I love this outfit
is because you gave it to me.

You wanna know why I love this place so much?
Because you're here.
You and I are gonna live happily ever after!

Bunnies aren't meant to be solitary creatures, you know.
They get lonely...

Don't be gone too long.
I'll be here waiting for you.

Gah! You scared me!
Where are you headed to?

Are there no other rabbits around?
Like Twinkling Bunny or Slippery Bunny?
All right, time to go out on a walk. Bounce, bounce!

Check it out,
I've got ears and a tail! Aren't they adorable?
Whoa, I can feel my power soaring!

Let's hang out, Rabbity.
We've got all night.

I can feel the magic in the air.
How did you do that?
You're the best, Rabbity! I feel so happy now!
Wowee! I'm gonna show this off to Queen.

Hmm... I don't have anything to give you in return...
Unless you want some carrots.
I just love you to bits, Rabbity.

Whenever I see you,
my heart won't stop racing.
Whenever you're around, I can't stop blushing.
I'm happy going anywhere, so long as you're with me.
Alice the Wonderland Bunny, reporting in!
Bounce, bounce!
Let's play together!
This seems like fun!
It's like playing hide-and-seek!
Are you ready? I'm ready!
Alice isn't home!
Just a sec.
Come and get me!
Ugh! It's carrots!
Gotcha, carrots!
See you in heaven!
Yahoo! Gotcha!
I did pretty good, don't you think?
This is fun!
Gah!
Whoa!
*Sob*
So tired... but I'm not done having fun yet...
I had a great time! Where to now?
